Tech Tuklas Adventure

Explore. Learn. Innovate.

Download and install the game on your Android phone in 9 steps.

  • techtuklas.apk, 41.30 MB
  • Android phones only
  • About 3 minutes

The download link

The game is in this Google Drive folder. Open it, then follow the steps below.

Open the Google Drive folder
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1K92SYZP0wbaDXCkXtZI47xrA91o-Ty2S

Before you start

What you need

An Android phone, Wi-Fi or mobile data, and at least 200 MB of free space.

Not for iPhone

The game is an Android app (an APK file). It does not install on iPhones or iPads.

About the warnings

Your phone will warn you a few times. That happens with every app that is not from the Play Store. Each warning is explained below.

Part 1: Google Drive

Steps 1 to 3: get the file from the Drive folder. These pictures were taken in Messenger. In Chrome they look almost the same.

1

Step 1: Tap techtuklas.apk

Open the Drive folder with the button at the top of this page. In the folder, tap the file techtuklas.apk.

If you opened the link from Messenger, it opens inside Messenger. That is fine, keep going.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
2

Step 2: Tap Download

Drive cannot show a preview of an app, so it says no preview is available. Tap Download. If your phone is set to Filipino, the button says I-download.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
3

Step 3: Tap Download anyway

Drive says the file is too large to scan for viruses. Tap the small grey Download anyway button under the file name.

Drive shows this for every big file it cannot scan. The game is safe to download.

From Messenger? Messenger may say you are leaving the app. Tap Continue and the download goes on in Chrome.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.

Part 2: Download

Steps 4 and 5: save the game to your phone. This part happens in Chrome.

4

Step 4: Tap Download anyway again

Chrome asks if you want to download a file that might be harmful. Tap Download anyway.

Chrome asks this for every app that is not from the Play Store. Check that it says techtuklas.apk and 41.30 MB.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
5

Step 5: Tap Open

When the download is done, a bar says File downloaded at the top. Tap Open.

The bar went away? Open your Files app, go to Downloads, and tap techtuklas.apk.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.

Part 3: Install

Steps 6 to 9: put the game on your phone and open it.

6

Step 6: Tap Install

Your phone asks if you want to install Tech Tuklas Adventure. Tap Install.

It says your phone is not allowed to install unknown apps? Tap Settings, turn on Allow from this source, go back, and tap Install.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
7

Step 7: Tap More details

Google Play Protect has not seen the game before, because it is not on the Play Store. Tap More details.

Scan app also works, but it sends the game to Google first and takes longer.

Do not tap Don't install app. That stops the install and you have to start again from step 5.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
8

Step 8: Tap Install without scanning

More options open up. Tap Install without scanning.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.
9

Step 9: Tap Open

The phone says App installed. Tap Open to start the game.

From now on, open it from your home screen or app list, like any other app.

Tap the picture to see it bigger.

Well done!

You downloaded and installed Tech Tuklas Adventure. Open it from your home screen or app list and start playing.

You can now delete techtuklas.apk from your Downloads. The game stays installed.

Tech Tuklas Adventure, a capstone game for DCIT 21A. The pictures on this page come from the game itself.

The screenshots were taken on an Android phone through Messenger and Chrome, so your screens may look a little different.
